title: Autonomous Swarm Coordination
mentorBio: Senior Research Scientist with 10 years in autonomous systems and swarm robotics. Specialises in multi-agent coordination, control systems, and field robotics for defence applications.
discipline: Computer Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Computer Science
description: Interns will develop coordination algorithms for autonomous swarm systems, covering multi-agent path planning, distributed control, and simulation-based validation. Deliverables include working prototypes, simulation benchmarks, and a technical report.

title: Cyber Threat Detection
mentorBio: Principal Engineer with 12 years in cyber defence and threat intelligence. Specialises in intrusion detection, malware analysis, and SIEM platforms for military networks.
discipline: Computer Science / Information Security / Computer Engineering
description: Interns will research and prototype cyber threat detection capabilities, including anomaly detection, log analysis, and network traffic classification. Deliverables include detection rules, evaluation benchmarks, and a technical report.

title: Radar Signal Classification
mentorBio: Principal Engineer with 15 years in radar signal processing and electronic warfare systems. Specialises in adaptive filtering, target detection under clutter, and signal classification for defence applications.
discipline: Applied Mathematics / Business Analytics / Electrical Engineering / Computer Engineering
description: Interns will contribute to radar signal classification work, including feature extraction, classifier prototyping, and performance evaluation against synthetic and operational datasets. Deliverables include working implementations, benchmarks, and a technical report.
